newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aluminum stocks downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aluminum stocks downgraded.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it downgraded its intermediate-term investment rating on various aluminum stocks. EVEREN said its short-term stock price targets have been met.
--Aluminum Co of America (Alcoa), Alcan Aluminium, Alumax Inc and Reynolds Metals Co were lowered to market performer from outperformer, while long-term outperform ratings were maintained.
--EVEREN said it maintained its rating of long-term and intermediate-term market performer on Kaiser Aluminium Corp.
--"Our top long-term outperform picks in the aluminum group continue to be Alcoa and Alumax," EVEREN said.
